verses.geez: ኵሎ ፡ ቃለ ፡ ዘአነ ፡ እኤዝዘከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ኪያሁ ፡ ዕቀብ ፡ ለገቢር ፡ ኢትወስክ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ወኢታንኪ ፡ እምኔሁ ።
verses.translation: Every word that I command you this day, it shalt thou observe to do: thou shalt not add to it, nor diminish from it.

translations.lxx: Every word that I command you this day, it shalt thou observe to do: thou shalt not add to it, nor diminish from it.
translations.kjv: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,
translations.ron: "De se va ridica în mijlocul tău prooroc sau văzător de vise şi va face înaintea ta semn şi minune,
translations.grk: Πᾶν ῥῆμα ὃ ἐγὼ ἐντλλομαι ὑμῖν σήμερον, τοῦτο φυλάξῃ ποιεῖν· οὐ προσθήσεις ἐπʼ αὐτό, οὐδὲ ἀφελεῖς ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወለእመኒ ፡ ተንሥአ ፡ እምኔከ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ አው ፡ ሐላሜ ፡ ሕልም ፡ ወገብረ ፡ ተአምረ ፡ አው ፡ መድምመ ፤
verses.translation: And if there arise within thee a prophet, or one who dreams a dream, and he gives thee a sign or a wonder,

translations.lxx: And if there arise within thee a prophet, or one who dreams a dream, and he gives thee a sign or a wonder,
translations.kjv: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;
translations.ron: Şi se va împlini semnul sau minunea aceea, de care ţi-a grăit el, şi-ţi va zice atunci: Să mergem după alţi dumnezei, pe care tu nu-i ştii şi să le slujim acelora,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ἀναστῇ ἐν σοὶ προφήτης ἢ ἐνυπνιαζόμενος τὸ ἐνύπνιον, καὶ δῷ σοι σημεῖον ἢ τέρας,

verses.geez:
ወበጽሐ ፡ ተአምሪሁ ፡ አው ፡ መድምም ፡ ዘይቤለከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ነዐ ፡ ንሑር ፡ ወናምልክ ፡ አማልክተ ፡
                  ዘኢታአምሩ ፤
verses.translation: and the sign or the wonder come to pass which he spoke to thee, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye know not;

translations.lxx: and the sign or the wonder come to pass which he spoke to thee, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye know not;
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
translations.ron: Să nu asculţi cuvintele proorocului aceluia sau ale acelui văzător de vise, că prin aceasta vă ispiteşte Domnul Dumnezeul vostru, ca să afle de iubiţi pe Domnul Dumnezeul vostru din toată inima voastră şi din tot sufletul vostru.
translations.grk: καὶ ἔλθῃ τὸ σημεῖον ἢ τὸ τέρας ὃ ἐλάλησε πρὸς σὲ, λέγων, πορευθῶμεν καὶ λατρεύσωμεν θεοῖς ἑτέροις οὓς οὐκ οἴδατε,

verses.geez:
ኢትስምዕዎ ፡ ቃሎ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ አው ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ሐላሜ ፡ ሕልም ፡ እስመ ፡ ያሜክረክሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አምላክክሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይርአይ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ታፈቅርዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ እምኵሉ ፡ ልብክሙ ፡ ወእምኵሉ ፡ ነፍስክሙ
                  ።
verses.translation: ye shall not hearken to the words of that prophet, or the dreamer of that dream, because the Lord thy God tries you, to know whether ye love your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

translations.lxx: ye shall not hearken to the words of that prophet, or the dreamer of that dream, because the Lord thy God tries you, to know whether ye love your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
translations.kjv: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
translations.ron: Domnului Dumnezeului vostru să-I urmaţi şi de El să vă temeţi; să păziţi poruncile Lui şi glasul Lui să-l ascultaţi; Lui să-I slujiţi şi de El să vă lipiţi.
translations.grk: οὐκ ἀκούσεσθε τῶν λόγων τοῦ προφήτου ἐκείνου ἢ τοῦ ἐνυπνιαζομένου τὸ ἐνύπνιον ἐκεῖνο· ὅτι πειράζει Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου ὑμᾶς, εἰδέναι εἰ ἀγαπᾶτε τὸν Θεὸν ὑμῶν ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας ὑμῶν, καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς ὑμῶν.

verses.geez:
ወትልውዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክክሙ ፡ ወኪያሁ ፡ ፍርሁ ፡ ወትእዛዞ ፡ ዕቀቡ ፡ ወቃሎ ፡ ስምዑ ፡ ወኀቤሁ ፡ ተማኅፀኑ
                  ።
verses.translation: Ye shall follow the Lord your God, and fear him, and ye shall hear his voice, and attach yourselves to him.

translations.lxx: Ye shall follow the Lord your God, and fear him, and ye shall hear his voice, and attach yourselves to him.
translations.kjv: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
translations.ron: Iar pe proorocul acela sau pe văzătorul acela de vise să-l daţi morţii, pentru că v-a sfătuit să vă abateţi de la Domnul Dumnezeul vostru, Cel ce v-a scos din pământul Egiptului şi v-a izbăvit din casa robiei, dorind să te abată de la calea pe care ţi-a poruncit Domnul Dumnezeul tău să mergi; pierde dar răul din mijlocul tău.
translations.grk: Ὀπίσω Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ ὑμῶν πορεύεσθε, καὶ τοῦτον φοβηθήσεσθε, καὶ τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσεσθε, καὶ αὐτῷ προστεθήσεσθε.

verses.geez:
ወዝክቱሰ ፡ ነቢይ ፡ አው ፡ ሐላሜ ፡ ሕልም ፡ ለይሙት ፡ እስመ ፡ ነገረከ ፡ በዘ ፡ ያስሕተከ ፡ እምነ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  አምላክከ ፡ ዘአውፅአከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ ወቤዘወከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ቅኔት ፡ ወእስመ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ ያኅድገ ፡ ፍኖተ ፡
                  እንተ ፡ አዘዘከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሑር ፡ ባቲ ፡ ወታሴስል ፡ ወታማስን ፡ እኩየ ፡ እምኔክሙ ።
verses.translation: And that prophet or that dreamer of a dream, shall die; for he has spoken to make thee err from the Lord thy God who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, who redeemed thee from bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the Lord thy God commanded thee to walk in: so shalt thou abolish the evil from among you.

translations.lxx: And that prophet or that dreamer of a dream, shall die; for he has spoken to make thee err from the Lord thy God who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, who redeemed thee from bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the Lord thy God commanded thee to walk in: so shalt thou abolish the evil from among you.
translations.kjv: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;
translations.ron: De te va îndemna în taină fratele tău, fiul tatălui tău, sau fiul mamei tale, sau fiul tău, sau fiica ta, sau femeia de la sânul tău, sau prietenul tău care este pentru tine ca sufletul tău, zicând: Haidem să slujim altor dumnezei, pe care tu şi părinţii tăi nu i-aţi ştiut,
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ προφήτης ἐκεῖνος ἢ ὁ τὸ ἐνύπνιον ἐνυπνιαζόμενος ἐκεῖνος, ἀποθανεῖται· ἐλάλησε γὰρ πλανῆσαί σε ἀπὸ Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου ἐξαγαγόντος σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, τοῦ λυτρωσαμένου σε ἐκ τῆς δουλείας, ἐξῶσαί σε ἀπὸ τῆς ὁδοῦ, ἧς ἐνετείλατό σοι Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου πορεύεσθαι ἐν αὐτῇ· καὶ ἀφανιεῖς τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወለእመኒ ፡ አስተበቍዐከ ፡ እኁከ ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ አቡከ ፡ አው ፡ ዘእምነ ፡ እምከ ፡ አው ፡ ወልድከ ፡ አው ፡ ወለትከ ፡
                  አው ፡ ብእሲትከ ፡ እንተ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሕፅንከ ፡ አው ፡ ዓርክከ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ነፍስከ ፡ ወይቤለከ ፡ በጽምሚት ፡ ነዐ ፡ ንሑር
                  ፡ ወናምልክ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ ባዕድ ፡ ዘኢታአምር ፡ አንተ ፡ ወአበዊከ ፤
verses.translation: And if thy brother by thy father or mother, or thy son, or daughter, or thy wife in thy bosom, or friend who is equal to thine own soul, entreat thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known,

translations.lxx: And if thy brother by thy father or mother, or thy son, or daughter, or thy wife in thy bosom, or friend who is equal to thine own soul, entreat thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known,
translations.kjv: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;
translations.ron: Dumnezeilor acelor popoare, care locuiesc împrejurul tău, aproape sau departe de tine, de la un capăt până la celălalt al pământului,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ παρακαλέσῃ σε ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἐκ πατρός σου ἢ ἐκ μητρός σου, ἢ ὁ υἱός σου, ἢ ἡ θυγάτηρ, ἢ ἡ γυνή σου ἡ ἐν κόλπῳ σου, ἢ φίλος ἴσος τῇ ψυχῇς σου λάθρα, λέγων, βαδίσωμεν καὶ λατρεύσωμεν θεοῖς ἑτέροις, οὓς οὐκ ᾔδεις σὺ καὶ οἱ πατέρες σου,

verses.geez:
እምውስተ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ እለ ፡ አውድክሙ ፡ ወእለ ፡ ቅሩብክሙ ፡ አው ፡ እምእለ ፡ ርኁቃን ፡ እምኔክሙ ፡
                  እምጽንፈ ፡ ምድር ፡ እስከ ፡ ጽንፈ ፡ ምድር ፤
verses.translation: of the gods of the nations that are round about you, who are near thee or at a distance from thee, from one end of the earth to the other;

translations.lxx: of the gods of the nations that are round about you, who are near thee or at a distance from thee, from one end of the earth to the other;
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:
translations.ron: Să nu te învoieşti cu ei, nici să-i asculţi; să nu-i cruţe ochii tăi, să nu-ţi fie milă de ei, nici să-i ascunzi;
translations.grk: ἀπὸ τῶν θεῶν τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν περὶ κύκλῳ ὑμῶν, τῶν ἐγγιζόντων σοι ἢ τῶν μακρὰν ἀπὸ σοῦ, ἀπʼ ἄκρου τῆς γῆς ἕως ἄκρου τῆς γῆς,

verses.geez: ኢትኅበር ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ወኢትስምዖ ፡ ወኢትምሐኮ ፡ ዐይንከ ፡ ወኢትምሐሮ ።
verses.translation: thou shalt not consent to him, neither shalt thou hearken to him; and thine eye shall not spare him, thou shalt feel no regret for him, neither shalt thou at all protect him:

translations.lxx: thou shalt not consent to him, neither shalt thou hearken to him; and thine eye shall not spare him, thou shalt feel no regret for him, neither shalt thou at all protect him:
translations.kjv: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
translations.ron: Ci ucide-i; mâna ta să fie înaintea tuturor asupra lor, ca să-i ucidă, şi apoi să urmeze mâinile a tot poporul.
translations.grk: οὐ συνθελήσεις αὐτῷ, καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσῃ αὐτοῦ, καὶ οὐ φείσεται ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ἐπʼ αὐτῷ, οὐκ ἐπιποθήσεις ἐπʼ αὐτῷ, οὐδʼ οὐ μὴ σκεπάσῃς αὐτόν·

verses.geez:
አይድዕ ፡ ወንግር ፡ በእንቲአሁ ፡ እደዊከ ፡ ይቅድማ ፡ ቀቲሎቶ ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ እደወ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ይወግራሁ ፡
                  በእብን ።
verses.translation: thou shalt surely report concerning him, and thy hands shall be upon him among the first to slay him, and the hands of all the people at the last.

translations.lxx: thou shalt surely report concerning him, and thy hands shall be upon him among the first to slay him, and the hands of all the people at the last.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
translations.ron: Să-i ucizi cu pietre până la moarte, că au încercat să te abată de la Domnul Dumnezeul tău, Care te-a scos din pământul Egiptului şi din casa robiei.
translations.grk: ἀναγγέλλων ἀναγγελεῖς περὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ αἱ χεῖρές σου ἔσονται ἐπʼ αὐτὸν ἐν πρώτοις ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτὸν, καὶ αἱ χεῖρες παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπʼ ἐσχάτῳ.

verses.geez:
ወይቅትልዎ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ ያርሕቀ ፡ እምእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ዘአውፅአከ ፡ እምነ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እምነ
                  ፡ ቤተ ፡ ቅኔት ።
verses.translation: And they shall stone him with stones, and he shall die, because he sought to draw thee away from the Lord thy God who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

translations.lxx: And they shall stone him with stones, and he shall die, because he sought to draw thee away from the Lord thy God who brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
translations.kjv: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.
translations.ron: Tot Israelul va auzi aceasta şi se va teme şi nu se vor mai apuca pe viitor să mai facă în mijlocul tău asemenea rău.
translations.grk: Καὶ λιθοβολήσουσιν αὐτὸν ἐν λίθοις, καὶ ἀποθανεῖται, ὅτι ἐζήτησεν ἀποστῆσαί σε ἀπὸ Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου τοῦ ἐξαγαγόντος σε ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου, ἐξ οἴκου δουλείας.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ሰሚዖ ፡ ይፍራህ ፡ ወኢይድግሙ ፡ እንከ ፡ ገቢረ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ውስቴትክሙ ።
verses.translation: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not again do according to this evil thing among you.

translations.lxx: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not again do according to this evil thing among you.
translations.kjv: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,
translations.ron: De vei auzi de vreuna din cetăţile tale, pe care Domnul Dumnezeul tău ţi le dă ca să locuieşti,
translations.grk: Καὶ πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ ἀκούσας φοβηθήσεται, καὶ οὐ προσθήσει ποιῆσαι ἔτι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ πονηρὸν τοῦτο ἐν ὑμῖν.

verses.geez:
ወለእመኒ ፡ ሰማዕከ ፡ በውስተ ፡ አሐቲ ፡ እምነ ፡ አህጉሪከ ፡ ዘወሀበከ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትንበር ፡
                  ህየ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፤
verses.translation: And if in one of thy cities which the Lord God gives thee to dwell therein, thou shalt hear men saying,

translations.lxx: And if in one of thy cities which the Lord God gives thee to dwell therein, thou shalt hear men saying,
translations.kjv: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;
translations.ron: Că s-au ivit în ea oameni necredincioşi dintre ai tăi şi au smintit pe locuitorii cetăţii lor, zicând: Haidem să slujim altor dumnezei, pe care voi nu i-aţi ştiut,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ἀκούσῃς ἐν μιᾷ τῶν πόλεών σου, ὧν Κύριος ὁ Θεός σου δίδωσί σοι κατοικεῖν σε ἐκεῖ, λεγόντων,

verses.geez:
ወፅኡ ፡ ዕደው ፡ ኃጥኣን ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ወአክሐድዎሙ ፡ ለኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡ ወይቤልዎሙ ፡
                  ንዑ ፡ ንሑር ፡ ወናምልክ ፡ ባዕደ ፡ አማልክተ ፡ ዘኢታአምሩ ፤
verses.translation: Evil men have gone out from you, and have caused all the inhabitants of their land to fall away, saying, Let us go and worship other gods, whom ye knew not,

translations.lxx: Evil men have gone out from you, and have caused all the inhabitants of their land to fall away, saying, Let us go and worship other gods, whom ye knew not,
translations.kjv: Then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;
translations.ron: Caută, cercetează şi întreabă bine, şi de va fi adevărat că s-a întâmplat urâciunea aceasta în mijlocul tău,
translations.grk: ἐξήλθοσαν ἄνδρες παράνομοι ἐξ ὑμῶν, καὶ ἀπέστησαν πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν, λέγοντες, πορευθῶμεν καὶ λατρεύσωμεν θεοῖς ἑτέροις, οὓς οὐκ ᾔδειτε,

verses.geez: ወትሴአል ፡ ወተሐትት ፡ ጥቀ ፡ ወእምከመ ፡ አማነ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ወጥዩቀ ፡ ነገሩ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ርኩስ ፡ ውስቴትክሙ ፤
verses.translation: then thou shalt enquire and ask, and search diligently, and behold, if the thing is clearly true, and this abomination has taken place among you,

translations.lxx: then thou shalt enquire and ask, and search diligently, and behold, if the thing is clearly true, and this abomination has taken place among you,
translations.kjv: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.
translations.ron: Să loveşti pe locuitorii acelei cetăţi cu ascuţişul sabiei, s-o dai, blestemului pe ea şi tot ce este în ea şi dobitoacele ei să le treci prin ascuţişul sabiei.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐτάσεις καὶ ἐρωτήσεις, καὶ ἐρευνήσεις σφόδρα, καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀληθὴς σαφῶς ὁ λόγος, γεγένηται τὸ βδέλυγμα τοῦτο ἐν ὑμῖν·

verses.geez:
ቀቲለ ፡ ትቀትሉ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ሀገር ፡ በኀፂን ፡ ወረጊመ ፡ ትረግምዋ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡
                  ዘሀለወ ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.translation: thou shalt utterly destroy all the dwellers in that land with the edge of the sword; ye shall solemnly curse it, and all things in it.

translations.lxx: thou shalt utterly destroy all the dwellers in that land with the edge of the sword; ye shall solemnly curse it, and all things in it.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.
translations.ron: Iar prăzile ei să le aduni toate în mijlocul pieţii ei şi să arzi cu foc cetatea şi toată prada ei, ca ardere de tot Domnului Dumnezeului tău; să fie ea pe vecie dărâmată şi niciodată să nu se mai zidească.
translations.grk: ἀναιρῶν ἀνελεῖς πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐκείνῃ ἐν φόνῳ μαχαίρας, ἀναθέματι ἀναθεματιεῖτε αὐτὴν, καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ.

verses.geez:
ወለኵሉ ፡ ንዋያ ፡ ታስተጋብእ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍናዊሃ ፡ ወታውዒ ፡ ሀገራ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ምስለ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ንዋያ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡
                  ሀገር ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ትገብራ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይነብር ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ለዓለም ፡ ወኢትትነደቅ ።
verses.translation: And all its spoils thou shalt gather into its public ways, and thou shalt burn the city with fire, and all its spoils publicly before the Lord thy God; and it shall be uninhabited for ever, it shall not be built again.

translations.lxx: And all its spoils thou shalt gather into its public ways, and thou shalt burn the city with fire, and all its spoils publicly before the Lord thy God; and it shall be uninhabited for ever, it shall not be built again.
translations.kjv: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;
translations.ron: Nimic din cele blestemate să nu se lipească de mâna ta, ca să-Şi potolească Domnul iuţimea mâniei Sale şi să-ţi dea milă şi îndurare, şi să te înmulţească, cum ţi-a grăit şi ţie şi cum S-a jurat părinţilor tăi,
translations.grk: Καὶ πάντα τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῆς συνάξεις εἰς τὰς διόδους αὐτῆς, καὶ ἐμπρήσεις τὴν πόλιν ἐν πυρὶ, καὶ πάντα τὰ σκῦλα αὐτῆς πανδημεὶ ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου· καὶ ἔσται ἀοίκητος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, οὐκ ἀνοικοδομηθήσεται ἔτι.

verses.geez:
ወኢትግስስ ፡ በእዴከ ፡ ምንተኒ ፡ ዘርጉም ፡ እምነ ፡ ዘውስቴታ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሚጥ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መዐቶ ፡ ወየሀብከ ፡
                  ምሕረተ ፡ ወይምሐርከ ፡ ወያስተባዝኅከ ፡ በከመ ፡ መሐለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለአበዊከ ፤
verses.translation: And there shall nothing of the cursed thing cleave to thy hand, that the Lord may turn from his fierce anger, and shew thee mercy, and pity thee, and multiply thee, as he sware to thy fathers;

translations.lxx: And there shall nothing of the cursed thing cleave to thy hand, that the Lord may turn from his fierce anger, and shew thee mercy, and pity thee, and multiply thee, as he sware to thy fathers;
translations.kjv: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.
translations.ron: De vei asculta glasul Domnului Dumnezeului tău, păzind toate poruncile Lui pe care ţi le dau acum şi făcând cele bune şi plăcute înaintea ochilor Domnului Dumnezeului tău".
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐ προσκολληθήσεται οὐδὲν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀναθέματος ἐν τῇ χειρί σου, ἵνα ἀποστραφῇ Κύριος ἀπὸ θυμοῦ τῆς ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ, καὶ δώσῃ σοι ἔλεος, καὶ ἐλεήσῇ σε, καὶ πληθύνῃ σε, ὃν τρόπον ὤμοσε τοῖς πατράσι σου,

verses.geez:
(ከመ ፡) ለእመ ፡ ሰሚዐ ፡ ሰማዕከ ፡ ቃለ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወዐቀብከ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአነ ፡
                  እኤዝዘከ ፡ ዮም ፡ ወገበርከ ፡ ዘሠናይ ፡ ወዘአደም ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ።
verses.translation: if thou wilt hear the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments, all that I charge thee this day, to do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord thy God.

translations.lxx: if thou wilt hear the voice of the Lord thy God, to keep his commandments, all that I charge thee this day, to do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord thy God.
translations.grk: ἐὰν ἀκούσῃς τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου, φυλάσσειν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ, ὅσας ἐγὼ ἐντέλλομαί σοι σήμερον, ποιεῖν τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ ἀρεστὸν ἐναντίον Κυρίου τοῦ Θεοῦ σου.
